Jwt.//Authority: REQUIRED outside Development: the OpenID Connect provider (https) whose published keys sign the access tokens.
Jwt.//SigningKey: Development only (HS256, >=32 bytes); refused elsewhere. Empty with no Authority = a built-in dev key.

Seed.//: SeedOnStartup requires the DB to be migrated. Set the admin password via user-secrets.

Cache.//PermissionExpiration: How long resolved permissions are cached: the longest a role change takes to reach a signed-in user.
